ops.caption: Pivot is the last element, 5, at position 6.
i=0: the next slot for a value smaller than the pivot. j=0: start scanning from the left.
j=0: a[0]=7 vs pivot 5. 7 is not smaller — no swap, i stays at 0.
Advance j to 1.
j=1: a[1]=2 vs pivot 5. 2 is smaller — swap it into position i=0.
Swap positions 1 and 0: 2 moves into the smaller region.
i advances to 1.
Advance j to 2.
j=2: a[2]=9 vs pivot 5. 9 is not smaller — no swap, i stays at 1.
Advance j to 3.
j=3: a[3]=4 vs pivot 5. 4 is smaller — swap it into position i=1.
Swap positions 3 and 1.
i advances to 2.
Advance j to 4.
j=4: a[4]=3 vs pivot 5. 3 is smaller — swap it into position i=2.
Swap positions 4 and 2.
i advances to 3.
Advance j to 5.
j=5: a[5]=8 vs pivot 5. 8 is not smaller — no swap, i stays at 3.
Scan complete. Now place the pivot at the boundary.
Swap the pivot into position i=3.
5 is now in its final place: everything left of it is smaller, everything right is larger.
